# Juka Media

> Juka Media (OÜ Juka Media, reg. code 17495980) is a web studio in Tallinn,
> Estonia, run directly by its founder — 20+ years in marketing, no account
> managers. Clients across the EU, Canada and the US. Websites are delivered
> in up to six languages: English, Russian, Estonian, German, French, Spanish.

## Services and prices (international, USD)

- One-page website: from $990, ready in 3-5 days
- Business website: from $2,400, 7-10 days
- Premium custom website: from $4,500, 2-3 weeks
- Online store: from $2,990, 3-4 weeks
- Turnkey business launch (website + domain + email + Google Business
  Profile + analytics): $990, 5-7 days
- Google Ads: setup $590, management $390/month
- AI assistant on the website: from $990, plus $49/month support
- Website care plans: $59-$390/month

Prices for Estonia and the EU are published in EUR: https://jukamedia.com/ru/pricing/
(websites from 690 €, turnkey launch 890 €, stores from 2,490 €).

## Terms

50% upfront, 50% on delivery; official invoice from an Estonian (EU)
company. Two revision rounds included. Month-to-month, no long-term
contracts; the client owns the domain, hosting and all accounts.
